definitions: A small, sharp-pointed organ at the end of the abdomen of bees, wasps, ants, and scorpions, capable of inflicting a painful wound by injecting venom.
A painful wound or mark caused by a sting.
A carefully planned operation, typically one involving an elaborate deception, to catch criminals or to detect and expose illicit activity.
A charge or cost, especially one that is unexpectedly high.
examples: He still had the red mark from the sting.
She felt a sting in her eye.
The police organised a sting operation.
The high price of the repairs was a real sting.
